title: KestrelCare Adjuster Decision Table: Re-Figuring an Approved Amount at Payment
content:
**Rule.** When a facility is paid for the repair work on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts decision, the amount is re-figured from the decision as follows: where the decision approved less than its estimate less the deductible and the coverage remaining now is above the approved amount, the amount is the estimate less the deductible or the coverage remaining now, whichever is lower; where the decision approved more than the coverage remaining now, the amount is the coverage remaining now; otherwise the amount is the approved amount.

The approved amount, the estimate the decision was made on and the deductible applied are those on the plan's approved claim decision entry being paid; the estimate less the deductible is never taken below zero. "Now" is the moment the payment is made.

| Approved amount compared with estimate less deductible | Coverage remaining now | Re-figured amount |
|---|---|---|
| below it | above the approved amount | the lower of estimate less deductible and coverage remaining now |
| any | below the approved amount | coverage remaining now |
| equal to it or above it | at or above the approved amount | the approved amount |
| below it | equal to the approved amount | the approved amount |

## Cases (hypothetical decisions)

| Approved | Estimate | Deductible | Coverage remaining now | Re-figured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2100.00 | 2600.00 | 100.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 |
| 2100.00 | 2600.00 | 100.00 | 2300.00 | 2300.00 |
| 3000.00 | 3100.00 | 100.00 | 1800.00 | 1800.00 |
| 2500.00 | 2600.00 | 100.00 | 4000.00 | 2500.00 |
